signIn.connectFirst: Connect to your Chat Systems server
signIn.connectAnother: Connect to another Chat Systems server
signIn.totpPrompt: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
signIn.passkeyPrompt: This server asks admins for a second factor. Confirm with your passkey.
signIn.websocketUrlHint: Only needed if the WebSocket server runs on a different port.
signIn.inviteOnly: Invite-only platform. Contact your admin for access.

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We'll email you a link to set a new one
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for <email>{{email}}</email>, a link to set a new password is on its way. It works for one hour.

emailCode.title: Sign in with a code
emailCode.subtitle: We'll email you a six-digit code instead of asking for your password
emailCode.askFailed: Could not send a code. Try again.
emailCode.sentBody: If <email>{{email}}</email> has an account here, a code is on its way. It works once, for ten minutes.
emailCode.offBody: This server does not send sign-in codes. Sign in with your password instead.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
resetPassword.doneBody: Your new password is set, and every device that was signed in has been signed out.
